name: co-VC dimension of Singletons plus empty set
details: Exact finite endpoint correction on the stated class domain. Original record preserved at sync/covc_endpoint_corrections/originals/025_covc_dimension_singletons_plus_empty_set.json.
proof: At $n=1$ the class is the full one-dimensional cube, so coVC is zero. For $n\ge2$, projection to any two coordinates has the empty trace and both singletons but not their doubleton, giving a hollow two-star. In any projection every realized set has size at most one. A missing set of size at least three has no one-coordinate deletion in the class; a missing set of size two can have all its flips realized only on its two-coordinate domain. Thus there is no larger hollow star.
